script: Start with one squeeze and watch the shape spring back. Try a fingertip press for a smaller, focused shape change. See the bright color mix up close, then finish by squeezing the whole colorful set together.

sentence_bindings.sentence: Start with one squeeze and watch the shape spring back.
sentence_bindings.claim: A squeeze visibly deforms the toy and it returns toward its open shape after release.
sentence_bindings.proof: Single blue unit: prepare, squeeze/deformation, release, readable returned state.
sentence_bindings.transition_intent: Open on the clearest single-unit action; exit on the stable open-palm result.

sentence_bindings.sentence: Try a fingertip press for a smaller, focused shape change.
sentence_bindings.claim: A fingertip press creates a visible local deformation.
sentence_bindings.proof: Orange/transparent unit: repeated local fingertip presses followed by recovery and hand exit.
sentence_bindings.transition_intent: Move from full-hand squeeze to a closer local gesture; enter before the first press and leave after recovery.

sentence_bindings.sentence: See the bright color mix up close, then finish by squeezing the whole colorful set together.
sentence_bindings.claim: The footage shows multiple bright colors and a complete group squeeze/release.
sentence_bindings.proof: Continuous push-in to the five-color group, followed by the complete multi-unit squeeze and release hero action.
sentence_bindings.transition_intent: Use the identity push-in as a neutral bridge into the wider multi-color payoff; finish on the readable released group.
